observations.description: Arsenal advance down the left against Norwich in yellow.
Cazorla moves infield and exchanges a short pass with Wilshere.
Wilshere and Giroud exchange quick first-time passes near the edge of the area.
Giroud returns the ball into the path of Wilshere running into the box.
Wilshere finishes beyond the goalkeeper and the ball crosses the line.
The replay shows the first-time passing exchange between Cazorla, Wilshere and Giroud.
Another replay follows Wilshere continuing his run after releasing the ball.

lines.text: What a move! What a goal!
Nobody stops the ball. Every touch takes another defender out of the move.
Wilshere never stops running. He passes, then goes again.
